preservation of assets pending an arbitration proceeding is maintainable?

19. Mr. Sundaram points out that the Arbitration Act, 1996 departs from the strict territorial
criterion/principle as not only it retains the features of New York Convention but significantly
departs from Model Law. The Model Law has sought to bring in an era of localized/territorial

arbitral seat is the location selected by the parties (or, sometimes, by the arbitrators,
